---
title: "Installing Visual Studio Code"
---

## Install Visual Studio Code

Visual Studio Code (vscode) is the recommended editor for this course. Please install it from [Visual Studio Code Downloads][1] page.

[1]: https://code.visualstudio.com/download

## Install WSL extension in vscode

Follow the following instructions to install the extension.

* Open `vscode` and press `Ctrl+P`
* Type `ext install ms-vscode-remote.remote-wsl` and press `Enter`
